work_item: QR codes reais (imagem) para check-in de Eventos/Séries e link de pré-checkin compartilhável para o administrador enviar aos alunos
next_action: All 10 acceptance criteria (QRL-01..QRL-10) plus all 3 non-blocking review follow-ups are now addressed: title no longer travels in the /checkin-print URL (moved to localStorage, read-once, with a 'Check-in' fallback), and a shared QrImage component replaced the duplicated QR markup. A real cross-tab-storage bug (sessionStorage doesn't survive rel=noopener new-tab boundaries) was caught via manual browser re-verification of the fix pass and corrected (switched to localStorage) before being reported done -- automated tests alone (Jest/jsdom, Cypress) could not have caught this. Gates re-confirmed by root after the fix: Jest 79/79, ESLint clean, tsc clean. Not committed/pushed yet -- awaiting user's explicit go-ahead.
